slides.title: Concept Introduction: What is a Prompt?
content: A prompt is a text instruction.
Given to an AI tool.
The AI reads it and gives an answer.
narration: What is a prompt?
Imagine you tell a smart helper what you need.
For example, 'Tell me a story about a brave rabbit'.
This instruction is a prompt.
slides.image_prompt: An illustration of a person typing a question into a glowing AI chatbot interface, with a thought bubble above the AI showing generated text. Simple, clear, and modern.

slides.title: Concept Development: Why Prompting is Important?
content: Helps AI understand your exact need.
Ensures useful and correct answers.
Saves time and effort.
narration: Why is prompting important?
If you ask a shopkeeper for 'some food', you might get anything.
Ask for 'one packet of milk', you get what you need.
A good prompt is like asking clearly.
slides.image_prompt: Two contrasting scenes: on the left, a confused shopkeeper reacting to a vague request (speech bubble 'some food'); on the right, a happy shopkeeper giving specific items (milk and bananas) to a customer with a clear request. Cartoon style, easy to understand.

slides.title: Core Concept 1: Be Clear and Specific
content: Avoid vague prompts. They confuse AI.
State exactly what information you need.
Use simple, direct words.
Example: 'Tell me five facts about India's geography'.
narration: Our first concept: Be Clear and Specific.
Vague prompts, like 'Tell me about India', confuse AI.
You may not get what you wanted.
Decide exactly what information you need.
Use simple, direct words.
slides.image_prompt: On the left, a cloud with a question mark, representing vague prompts. On the right, a magnifying glass focusing on a specific item, representing clear and specific prompts. Use a world map outline as background for the 'India' example.

slides.title: Core Concept 2: Add Context and Role
content: AI needs background information.
Tell AI its role (e.g., 'You are a teacher').
Makes AI answers more relevant.
Example: 'You are a student. Write an email to your professor asking for an extension'.
narration: Next, we learn about 'Adding Context and Role'.
AI tools do not know your situation.
Giving context helps AI understand your needs.
Tell the AI its role, like 'You are a teacher'.
Example: As a student, email your professor for an extension.
slides.image_prompt: A split image: on the left, an AI chatbot icon with a question mark about user's context. On the right, the AI icon wearing various 'hats' (e.g., a graduation cap for student, a stethoscope for doctor) with text bubbles showing clear role and context. Dynamic and illustrative.

slides.title: Core Concept 3: Specify Format and Length
content: Tell AI how you want the answer structured.
Specify length (e.g., 'three bullet points', '100 words').
Ensures easy-to-read, suitable output.
Example: 'List five benefits of exercise as a numbered list'.
narration: Finally, Specify Format and Length.
AI can give answers in many ways.
Tell AI how you want the answer structured, like 'in bullet points'.
Also, specify the length, for example, 'in 100 words'.
Example: 'List five benefits of exercise, as a numbered list'.
slides.image_prompt: A graphic demonstrating different output formats: a bulleted list, a numbered list, a short paragraph, and a table. A ruler icon or a counter for 'length' is also shown. Clean, professional data visualization style.

slides.title: Practical Activity: Planning a Daily Schedule
content: Task: Plan a simple daily schedule for a student.
Role: 'You are a personal assistant.'
Context: 'Student needs 3 hrs study, 1 hr exercise, 2 hrs relax. Day 7 AM to 10 PM.'
Format: 'As a table with columns: Time, Activity.'

Full Prompt: 'You are a personal assistant. I need a daily schedule for a student who wants to study for 3 hours, exercise for 1 hour, and relax for 2 hours. Start the day at 7 AM and end at 10 PM. Present the schedule as a simple table with two columns: 'Time' and 'Activity'. Make sure each activity has a clear time slot.'
narration: Let's combine all concepts for a practical activity.
We will plan a daily schedule for a student using AI.
Here is the full prompt to use:
You can see it on your screen.
Pause this video now.
Type this prompt into your AI tool.
